## Checklist

- [ ] Full record has been reviewed and approved by the human author
- [ ] `cdh_schema_version` is the supported v0.5.0 release
- [ ] Links resolve (the Check links job will flag any that don't)
- [ ] Hosted assets pass cloud-format validation and remote partial-read checks
- [ ] Attribution, original source, processing changes and checksums are documented
- [ ] Unresolved facts are explicit; no invented dates or ownership
